newsitem.title: USA: Cusiana crude placed at WTI -85 cts/bbl fob.
newsitem.headline: Cusiana crude placed at WTI -85 cts/bbl fob.

text.p: British Petroleum sold a cargo of Colombian Cusiana crude oil at 85 cents a barrel under benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing fob, trade sources said on Wednesday.
The gasoline-rich grade, one of Latin America's most closely watched, was last placed at 90 cents under WTI.
The discount has decreased over the past week in response to the narrow WTI/Brent spread and softening freight rates in the Caribbean, trade sources said.
Five more August cargoes of Cusiana, plus a cross-month loader into September, are still available.
